description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter (`ContentRowAdapter`) for rendering a list of content rows. Each row includes a title and a horizontally scrolling list of content cards. It manages focus behavior to ensure the row title remains visible when a child card gains focus, implementing custom scroll logic to improve user experience on Android TV.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying rows of content, each with a title and horizontal list of items.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual content row which manages title and inner recycler view.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Method inherited from ListAdapter to submit a list of ContentRow items for display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder for a content row.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a given position in the list.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Initializes the content for a row, including setting the title and configuring the inner RecyclerView.
